objective: Verify full-output permutation behavior without relying on a single golden vector.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the two launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata1 and odata2.
pass_condition: Pass iff odata1 is a permutation of the source (each source value appears exactly once) and odata2 is bitwise identical to the original source.
setup: Use unique source bit patterns; run forward shift (a,b), then run the inverse shift (-a,-b) over the first output storage; capture both outputs.
